mods.name: Marker Tools for Axiom
mods.description: An Axiom add-on for marker entities: create them from a selection or the display screen, resize them with gizmos, pick colors, and see region markers from further away.

releases.notes:
## Fixes
- Resize handles now work like Axiom's Box Select corners: they sit on the outer corners of the box, their arrows point outwards, and only one gizmo shows its arrows at a time. Click a corner to activate it; click Axiom's move gizmo to go back to moving.
- Handles can be hovered and dragged in game, not only in the editor, with the same button Axiom uses for marker gizmos (right click in game, left click in the editor). Clicking a handle no longer deselects the marker.
- Handle centers use the marker's line color (white when it is too dark) and keep a minimum on-screen size.
- New mod icon.

releases.notes:
First release of Marker Tools for Axiom, an unofficial client-side add-on for Axiom marker entities.

## Features
- Marker tab in Axiom's "create display entity" screen
- Marker builder tool next to the hotbar (LMB/RMB corners, Enter to create)
- Marker tool in the editor toolbar with Axiom's corner gizmos
- Resize gizmos on the selected marker
- Improved marker edit screen with an RGBA color picker
- Marker range option, measured to the nearest point of the box
- English and Brazilian Portuguese

## Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.11, Fabric Loader 0.20.1+, Fabric API
- Axiom 6.1.5+ (6.1.x)
- Server: AxiomPaper with `send-markers: true` and entity spawn/manipulate permissions
